title: docs: reconcile live Vast GPU fleet
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Updates the live Vast inventory to FLUX instance `49145048` and DreamShaper instance `49063196`.
- Corrects current fleet burn to `$1.117222/hour` and `$804.40` per 30-day month.
- Aligns the FLUX and DreamShaper deployment documentation with the six active production workers.
- Adds the replacement instance IDs to the economics workload attribution registry.

Validation:
- Live Vast inventory: six running production instances, no spare canary or stopped storage.
- Production heartbeat registry and worker health routes passed.
- `jq empty` and `git diff --check` passed.

gist.headline: Fleet map matches the bees
gist.blurb: The Vast GPU garden got its labels checked against reality. Six production workers, their current homes, and the burn meter now agree with each other.
gist.summary: Reconciled the live Vast fleet documentation and workload registry with FLUX instance 49145048, DreamShaper instance 49063196, six active production workers, and a recorded burn rate of $1.117222 per hour ($804.40 per 30-day month).
gist.impact: Operators now have current instance IDs, deployment references, health-checked worker inventory, and economics attribution for the active FLUX and DreamShaper fleet.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy server-garden inventory scene: Polli, wearing a tiny operations headset and clipboard, checks six glowing pixel server pots with clear FLUX and DreamShaper labels while a friendly CRT monitor robot verifies the fleet map. Vines, flowers, and code-plants connect the servers to an updated registry board, representing documentation and workload attribution being brought into sync.
